US Green Card Availability Shifts for Indian Applicants

The U.S. Department of State has issued its September Visa Bulletin, indicating shifts in green card availability for Indian nationals. While family-sponsored visa categories have seen significant advancements in cut-off dates, easing wait times, the EB-1 visa category for professionals faces a potential temporary unavailability within weeks due to high demand. This category has seen minimal progress in its cut-off dates. Separately, the U.S. has paused diversity visa issuance globally for a security review, a move that could affect Indian applicants.
